'''Vel''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. After a prototype Imperial [[Starship/Legends|starship]] was accidentally scrapped on the junk [[Moon/Legends|moons]] of [[Axxila/Legends|Axxila]], Vel hired scavengers to recover the starship, and launched an investigation afterwards.<ref name="Mission" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vel was first mentioned in the Scavenging crew skill mission "Throwing Out Diamonds" in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''. With Game Update 4.1, the mission was made available to both factions, and Vel was referred to as faction-ambiguous "Admiral Vel."
